query:
SELECT d.`projectId`, p.name, COUNT(*) as reviewed_count 
FROM documents d 
JOIN projects p ON p.id = d.`projectId`
WHERE d.status IN ('reviewed', 'flagged') 
GROUP BY d.`projectId`, p.name;
